In [[Six-dimensional space|six-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''quarter 6-cubic honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]). It has half the vertices of the [[6-demicubic honeycomb]], and a quarter of the vertices of a [[6-cube honeycomb]].<ref>Coxeter, '''Regular and Semi-Regular Polytopes III''', (1988), p318</ref> Its facets are [[6-demicube]]s, [[stericated 6-demicube]]s, and {3,3}×{3,3} [[duoprism]]s.
